name: F1 Live
author: nocram
description: Live F1 in the Omarchy bar: a live timing tower while a session is running, live driver standings carrying the points gap from your pinned driver (Max Verstappen by default) to the championship leader, plus the next Grand Prix countdown and the full weekend schedule in your local timezone.

barWidget.description: One bar pill and one panel: a live timing tower with positions, intervals, gaps and pit stops while a session runs, live driver standings showing the points gap your pinned driver (Max Verstappen by default) carries to the championship leader, the next race countdown, the full weekend schedule in laptop-local time, the circuit map, the qualifying grid, and upcoming races.

schema.label: Time format
schema.description: All times are always shown in this laptop's own timezone; this only picks the clock style.

schema.label: Switch to live mode automatically
schema.description: Open the panel on the live dashboard while a race session is running. The manual toggle always wins.

schema.label: Live refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: Only polled while live mode is on and a session is actually running.

schema.label: Notify this many minutes before
schema.description: Comma-separated, e.g. "60,30,15". A start and a finish notification are always sent for the sessions selected below.

schema.label: Always-visible driver
schema.description: Pinned below the top five whenever they fall outside it. Match on surname, code, or driver id.
